title: Laredo Housing Authority Opens Three Waiting Lists: Zapata, Asherton and Senior Housing
excerpt: The Housing Authority of the City of Laredo is opening waiting lists for three housing programs: the Housing Choice Voucher program in Zapata, the Housing Choice Voucher program in Asherton, and the Low Rent Elderly program for seniors in Laredo. Pre-applications are accepted in person only, on specific dates and times.
content:
The Housing Authority of the City of Laredo is opening waiting lists for three housing programs, the agency announced Monday, Nov. 16: the Housing Choice Voucher program in Zapata, the Housing Choice Voucher program in Asherton, and the Low Rent Elderly program for seniors in Laredo.

For the Zapata Housing Choice Voucher program, pre-applications will be accepted in person on Monday, Nov. 30, Monday, Dec. 14, and Monday, Dec. 28, from 10:00 AM to 3:00 PM at 607 US 83 in Zapata. The first date on the notice, Monday, Nov. 16, had already passed by the time the agency posted about it in the evening.

For the Asherton Housing Choice Voucher program, pre-applications will be accepted in person on Tuesday, Nov. 17 and Tuesday, Nov. 24, from 8:30 AM to 11:30 AM at 600 Cleveland Street, Apt. #17, in Asherton. The first date on the notice, Tuesday, Nov. 10, has already passed.

For the Low Rent Elderly program, pre-applications will be accepted in person every Thursday, beginning Nov. 12 and continuing until further notice, from 8:30 AM to 11:30 AM at 2000 San Francisco Avenue in Laredo. The next acceptance day is Thursday, Nov. 19. The program covers two-bedroom homes at Senior Home, 700 Juarez Avenue, and the Meadow Elderly Rental Assistance Demonstration program at 3119 Seymour Circle.

No pre-applications will be accepted before the listed dates, and none will be accepted online — applications are in person only. Applicants will be placed on the waiting lists by date and time, weighted by preferences, the agency said. For disability accommodations, call (956) 764-9396 for the Zapata and senior programs, or (956) 764-0996 for the Asherton program.

A note on timing: the Housing Authority's social media posts say the lists will be opening “tomorrow,” but the official public notices set the specific dates listed above. The notice dates are the ones that count — including the Zapata date of Nov. 16, which had already passed when the posts went up.

Source: Laredo Housing Authority, Nov. 16, 2026; Housing Authority of the City of Laredo public notices.
